plan.notes: Official Fullerton College Program Pathways Mapper (fullcoll.programmapper.com), site-content year 2025-2026; pathway “to Certificate”. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total credits (18) = sum of published pathway slots. Per-course prerequisites are not published in structured form on the mapper, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the official catalog's course descriptions for official prerequisites. A prerequisite naming a course outside the published pathway would be listed in external_prereqs, never invented into a term. The official map also shows 1 advising milestone(s) (e.g. graduation-application reminders); these are not credit-bearing requirements and are not modeled as courses.

courses.title: Choose a course
courses.choice_note: Choose one course from the official map's “Choose a course” list (12 options). Recommended/first option: ACCT 110 F. Map description: Choose a course from the following. Students need a total of 9 units minimum from this list to complete this requirement. BUS 111F, BUS 211F and BUS 211HF can only count for one course from this list. Do not take two of these courses (BUS 111F or BUS 211F or BUS 211HF) they are considered "OR" courses. Refer to catalog for clarification. https://catalog.nocccd.edu/fullerton-college/degrees-certificates/business/human-resources-management-certificate/
